messages.content:
Inspect this flowchart image against the requested process. Identify up to 4 specific mistakes: missing stages, wrong arrow direction or branch, overlapping boxes, unreadable text. Name the visible labels involved. Do not invent an error if the image is unclear. Return a short list of concrete corrections.

Requested process:
Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Begin with "Visit begins", then "Read admission rules", then the decision "Member?". Its Yes branch goes to "Show membership card"; its No branch goes to "Buy ticket". Both alternative stages lead directly to "Enter gallery", which leads to "Admission complete".

response.text: Visit begins is connected with Read admission rules which is then connected with Member? If Member? is No then Buy ticket and if Member? is Yes then Show membership card which is then connected with Enter gallery which is further connected with Admission complete. Also, Enter gallery is connected with both Admission complete and Show membership card. If Show membership card is No then Read admission rules and if Show membership card is Yes then Member? which is then connected with Enter gallery. Also, Admission complete is connected with Enter gallery which is then connected with Admission complete.
